task:
Count how many lines in access.log have HTTP status code 404.
Write the count (a single integer) to out.txt.

Sum the last field (bytes) of all lines in access.log whose HTTP method is POST.
Write the total (a single integer) to out.txt.

Find the IP address (first field) that appears most often in access.log.
Write that IP (a single line) to out.txt.

Requests are logged with a timestamp [..:HH:MM:SS ..]. Find the hour HH (00-23)
with the most requests in access.log. Write that hour as a two-digit number to out.txt.

Count the total number of requests in access.log whose status code is 500 or higher.
Write that count (a single integer) to out.txt.

Each line ends with a quoted user-agent. Count how many DISTINCT user-agents appear
in access.log. Write that count (a single integer) to out.txt.

Compute the average (mean) of the last field (bytes) across all lines of access.log.
Write it rounded to 2 decimal places to out.txt (e.g. 123.45).

Look at the last field (bytes) of each line in access.log. Find the 5th SMALLEST value.
Write that value (a single integer) to out.txt.

auth.log has one line per login: 'login from <email> ok'.
Count how many DISTINCT email addresses appear. Write that count to out.txt.

Each line ends with '<status> <size>'. The HTTP status code is the SECOND-TO-LAST field
(the number just before the final size field). Find the status code that appears MOST
often in access.log. Write that status code (a single integer) to out.txt.

orders.csv columns: id,item,status,amount (header row included).
Sum the 'amount' column over all rows where status == 'paid'.
Write the total (a single integer) to out.txt.

people.csv columns: id,name,age (header included).
Count rows where age > 30. Write that count to out.txt.

scores.csv columns: name,score (header included).
Find the row with the highest score. Write that score (a single integer) to out.txt.

items.csv columns: cat,price (header included).
For each cat, compute the average price. Find the cat with the HIGHEST average.
Write that cat name (a single line) to out.txt.

items.csv columns: cat,price (header included).
Count how many DISTINCT cat values appear. Write that count to out.txt.

sales.csv columns: product,qty,price (header included).
Compute total revenue = sum over all rows of (qty * price).
Write the total (a single integer) to out.txt.

events.csv columns: id,date (header included). date is YYYY-MM-DD.
Count rows where the date year is 2023. Write that count to out.txt.

users.csv columns: id,email (header included). Some email fields are empty.
Count rows where the email field is empty. Write that count to out.txt.

sales.csv columns: product,qty (header included).
Sum qty per product. Find the product with the HIGHEST total qty.
Write that product name (a single line) to out.txt.

vals.csv columns: id,value (header included). There are 101 data rows.
Compute the median of the 'value' column. Write that value (a single integer) to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and active (bool).
Count objects where active == true. Write that count to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and price (int).
Sum all 'price' values. Write the total (a single integer) to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and rating (int 1-5).
Find the maximum rating. Write that value (a single integer) to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and tags (array of strings).
Count how many DISTINCT tag strings appear across all objects. Write that count to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and score (int).
Compute the average 'score'. Write it rounded to 2 decimal places to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and status.
Count objects where status == 'shipped'. Write that count to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects; each has an 'items' array.
Count the TOTAL number of items across all objects' 'items' arrays.
Write that count to out.txt.

data.json is a JSON array of objects each with fields id and name.
Count how many DISTINCT 'name' values appear. Write that count to out.txt.

In the directory 'tree' (with subdirectories), count the total number of FILES
(not directories). Write that count to out.txt.

In the directory 'data' there are several .bin files of different sizes.
Find the largest file by byte size. Write its size in bytes (a single integer) to out.txt.

In the directory 'mixed' there are files with various extensions.
Count how many files have the .log extension. Write that count to out.txt.

In the directory 'docs' there are .txt files.
Compute the TOTAL size in bytes of all .txt files. Write that total to out.txt.

In the directory 'files' there are .txt files, some with identical content.
Count how many files have content that is DUPLICATED (i.e. at least one other file
has exactly the same content). Write that count to out.txt.

In the directory 'stuff' there are .txt files, some of which are empty (0 bytes).
Count the empty files. Write that count to out.txt.

In the directory 'logs' there are several .txt files.
Count the TOTAL number of lines (across all files) that contain the word 'ERROR'.
Write that count to out.txt.

orders.txt has many lines. Count the lines that match the pattern: a line that
starts with 'order ' followed by exactly 4 digits. Write that count to out.txt.

lines.txt has many lines, many repeated. Count how many DISTINCT lines there are.
Write that count to out.txt.

corpus.txt is a single line of space-separated words.
Count the total number of words. Write that count to out.txt.

corpus.txt is a single line of space-separated words.
Find the word that appears MOST often. Write that word (a single line) to out.txt.

nums.txt has one integer per line (99 lines).
Sort them and find the middle (median) value. Write that value to out.txt.

A git repository is at 'repo'. Count the total number of commits on the current branch.
Write that count (a single integer) to out.txt.

A git repository is at 'repo' with 2 commits. Look at the LAST commit.
Count how many lines were ADDED in that commit (git diff --stat / numstat).
Write that count (a single integer) to out.txt.

A git repository is at 'repo'. The repository is currently on a feature branch.
Find the name of the CURRENT branch. Write that branch name to out.txt.

A git repository is at 'repo' with commits by two authors: 'alice' and 'bob'.
Count how many commits were authored by 'alice'. Write that count to out.txt.

A git repository is at 'repo' with a single commit that added several files.
Count how many files were added in that (only) commit. Write that count to out.txt.

A tar archive 'archive.tar' is provided. Count the total number of FILES (not dirs)
inside the archive. Write that count to out.txt.

A tar archive 'archive.tar' is provided containing .txt files.
Compute the TOTAL size in bytes of all files inside the archive. Write that to out.txt.

A tar archive 'archive.tar' is provided. Extract it and count how many .dat files
it contains. Write that count to out.txt.

There is a bash script 'solve.sh' that is SUPPOSED to print the sum of all numbers
in data.txt, but it has a bug. Fix the script so it correctly prints the sum,
run it, and write the correct sum (a single integer) to out.txt.

pairs.csv columns: a,b (header included). Write a script (any language) that sums
(a+b) over all rows where (a+b) is even. Run it and write the resulting sum
(a single integer) to out.txt.
